name: Danzai Shitsu
source:
A self-proclaimed victim and someone called the perpetrator by the self-proclaimed victim will appear.

You will listen to the conversation between the two and decide whether it is okay for the victim to take revenge on the perpetrator.

However, please do so carefully. Revenge in this case means "the murder of the perpetrator by the victim."

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3577000/]Steam[/url]]
